commands.name: new
commands.description: Start a fresh session; add a name to title it, 'now' or -y to skip the question

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear the screen and start a fresh session

commands.name: history
commands.description: Show this conversation so far

commands.name: title
commands.description: Show or set the title of this session

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Switch to an earlier session by title, id or list number

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: List recent sessions to pick one to resume

commands.name: retry
commands.description: Take back your last message and send it again

commands.name: undo
commands.description: Take back your last N messages and their replies (default 1)

commands.name: save
commands.description: Write this conversation to a file as JSON lines, Markdown or HTML

commands.name: branch
commands.description: Copy this conversation into a new session and continue there

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Stop the running reply and this session's background processes

commands.name: steer
commands.description: Add guidance to the running reply after its next tool call

commands.name: queue
commands.description: Line up a message for after the current reply; list, clear or remove queued ones

commands.name: compress
commands.description: Summarise older turns to free context

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the session, model and approval state

commands.name: context
commands.description: Show how much of the context window is in use

commands.name: btw
commands.description: Ask a side question without changing the conversation

commands.name: goal
commands.description: Set a standing goal the agent keeps working towards

commands.name: subgoal
commands.description: Add, tick off or list extra criteria of the current goal

commands.name: loop
commands.description: Repeat a prompt in this session on an interval

commands.name: heartbeat
commands.description: Send a recurring prompt into this session while it is idle

commands.name: moa
commands.description: Answer with the advice of several models (this prompt, or on/off for the session)

commands.name: agents
commands.description: Show running helper agents and background tasks

commands.name: refine
commands.description: Review this conversation now and keep what was learned

commands.name: journey
commands.description: Browse what the agent has learned over time

commands.name: rollback
commands.description: List or restore file checkpoints

commands.name: worktree
commands.description: Create, list or prune isolated git worktrees

commands.name: approve
commands.description: Approve the command waiting for an answer

commands.name: deny
commands.description: Refuse the command waiting for an answer

commands.name: bg
commands.description: Run a prompt in a separate background session and post the result here

commands.name: model
commands.description: Show or switch the model; --global also saves it

commands.name: reasoning
commands.description: Show or set reasoning effort, or show/hide reasoning text

commands.name: yolo
commands.description: Turn auto-approval of risky commands on or off for this session

commands.name: approvals
commands.description: Show or save how risky commands are approved

commands.name: fast
commands.description: Ask the provider for faster processing

commands.name: config
commands.description: Show the effective settings with secrets masked

commands.name: sethome
commands.description: Make this chat the home channel for scheduled results and notices

commands.name: platform
commands.description: List messaging platforms, or pause / resume one

commands.name: verbose
commands.description: Change how much tool activity this chat shows

commands.name: personality
commands.description: Show or pick the agent's personality

commands.name: voice
commands.description: Turn voice input and spoken replies on or off

commands.name: tools
commands.description: List tools, or enable/disable toolsets (starts a fresh session)

commands.name: skills
commands.description: Find, install and manage skills

commands.name: reload-skills
commands.description: Rescan skill folders and refresh skill commands (the prompt stays as it is)

commands.name: bundles
commands.description: List skill bundles (each runs as its own /command)

commands.name: memory
commands.description: Review memory writes waiting for approval

commands.name: learn
commands.description: Turn something you describe into a reusable skill

commands.name: curator
commands.description: Background upkeep of skills

commands.name: browser
commands.description: Connect the browser tools to a running browser

commands.name: checkpoints
commands.description: Turn file checkpoints on or off

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Show connected MCP servers

commands.name: reload-mcp
commands.description: Reconnect MCP servers from the config

commands.name: plugins
commands.description: List plugins, or enable/disable one for this profile

commands.name: cron
commands.description: Manage scheduled jobs

commands.name: suggestions
commands.description: List suggested jobs; accept or dismiss one

commands.name: blueprint
commands.description: Set up a job from a blueprint; with no name, list them

commands.name: help
commands.description: List commands; add a word to filter them

commands.name: commands
commands.description: List every command you can run here, names only

commands.name: usage
commands.description: Show token use and cost of this session

commands.name: whoami
commands.description: Show the profile, home and session you are on

commands.name: version
commands.description: Show the Indus Agent version

commands.name: quit
commands.description: Leave Indus Agent
